I have played Gardenscapes for many years and it used to be the best game. However, over the past year, things seem to have changed dramatically.

Power-ups have been altered and ordinary levels have become so difficult that completing them without spending money or using nearly every available power-up often feels impossible. The game now seems designed to create frustration and sell solutions. It never felt that way before.

There also used to be meaningful rewards and bonus opportunities for loyal paying players. Now you rarely receive those benefits, making you feel like a fool for spending any money.

Gardenscapes once felt enjoyable and worth supporting; now it seems increasingly focused on extracting more money from its players. I won’t ever play again.

title: Every new update gets worse

This game was fun - until the developers decided to max out their earning opportunities at the detriment of the player experience (which will I hope lead to more people refusing to pay to play).

After increasing the cost of the Garden Pass, they also increased the AI game mechanics which result in failure - I used all the bonuses earned from paying 10 USD for the garden pass in one day, only to fail multiple times. I remember having long streaks and really enjoying my playtime, now every single time you achieve the Super Rainbow Blast - it’s 90% likely you’ll fail the next level; making it impossible to maintain streaks without paying (way too much).

author: ElpadreEZ
title: Greed has taken over this once awesome game.
content:
I’ve played Gardenscapes on and off for years, and it’s disappointing to see what this game has become. It used to be fun because there was a good balance of easy, medium, and hard levels. Some levels challenged you, some were relaxing, but overall it felt fair. You could actually make progress without feeling like you had to spend money.

Once you get past level 11,000, that balance is gone. Almost every level feels like a Hard or Super Hard level, even the ones that aren’t labeled that way. The difficulty feels intentionally increased to push players toward buying coins, boosters, and extra moves.

The coin rewards are also terrible. You can spend multiple lives and boosters trying to beat a difficult level, only to get rewarded with a small amount of coins that doesn’t come close to replacing what you used. The payout system makes progression feel like a constant struggle.

Gardenscapes has gone from a fun puzzle game to a pay-to-win cash grab. Instead of rewarding the players who have stuck with this game for years, the developers have made it more and more frustrating unless you’re willing to spend money.

It’s disappointing because this used to be one of my favorite games. After years of playing, I find myself enjoying it less and less because the focus seems to have shifted from creating a fun experience to finding more ways to get players to pay. Unless you’re willing to spend money, expect more frustration than fun.

title: Pay to play game
content:
This game is advertised as free-to-play, but in reality it has become pay-to-play. The gameplay feels heavily manipulated by an algorithm designed to push players into spending money.

Boosters often make little difference when trying to pass difficult levels. What is even more frustrating is that whenever you’re close to reaching a milestone in a competition or event, even easy levels suddenly become almost impossible to beat. It feels as if the game deliberately reduces your chances of winning until you either spend money or give up.

A challenging game is fine, but artificial difficulty designed to maximize purchases is not. This isn’t rewarding gameplay, it’s a monetization strategy that undermines the entire experience. I can no longer recommend this game.

author: Bellabell94
title: The quality of power-ups and bonuses are seriously declining!
content: Every time there is a game update power-ups are either taken away, or are “made worse.” The game went from double bombs and a combo, dynamite and rainbow boost, to a just a single bomb, and they got rid of the combo, dynamite and rainbow boost. They also changed the in-game boosters in which they got rid of the “hand” to switch two tiles, (which actually required some skill to use), and replaced it with a less than helpful “shuffle fan.” There used to be a power-up that erased both a whole row and a whole column with just one power-up, but now they split that booster in half and made a target and a weight, so now you need two separate boosters to achieve the same result as the old booster did with using inly one booster. They added a “special” level a few years ago, where you only get one chance to beat it, but you were awarded with 15 minutes of unlimited bombs, but they’ve taken that away and now you are awarded next to nothing. But don’t worry, the special level will take away all of the power ups that you’ve worked up to earn, or buy, so instead of it being a “special round”, it is more or less a “go back to home and start over with nothing round.” The exploring mini game now just gives extra lighting bolts in the bonus, but before it would give boosters such as bombs and dynamite. And don’t even get me started on collecting “cards!” while I could see it would be fun to collect cards as a team, they make it so hard to collect the gold cards that you’re stuck trying to get one last gold card for weeks! So now when I’m getting a bonus for four cards that I already have multiples of is no “bonus” to me at all! Also, when collecting grapes, or producing so many bombs in order to achieve a bonus, they used to give 30 minutes to 1 hour of unlimited bombs or dynamite, that has been cut back to now only offering 10 minutes of bonus boosters! Same complaint about buying the booster season upgrades, now the replacing actual boosters, such as bombs and dynamite that were 30 minutes to an hour, down to 10 minutes and a bunch of extra duplicate cards to collect that offer nothing! This is so disheartening to see such decline in this game since I have been playing this game for seven years now!

author: jakeisthewolf
title: Used to be my favorite game…
content: I’ve played this game for years. It used to be my truly favorite game of all - to the point where it was a running joke in my life that if I was on my phone, I was probably playing it. Over time there have been increasing changes made to the game that make it far more difficult and at times seemingly impossible - unless you spend money. There is an event called “Electric Showdown” where you get an hour of free play time to compete against other players (the player to win the most levels wins a prize). On multiple occasions I have spent the entire hour on a “basic” level. Harder levels can take DAYS to beat. Power boosts have been degraded repeatedly over time. To complete your “day” and earn a reward (which used to be far more fruitful than it is now) you must beat over 100 levels. I’ve become so fed up and frustrated with this game that I have actually downloaded new games onto my phone. Just to be clear, in this game you will eventually join a “team” where you are able to chat with your teammates in a group message. My teammates are wonderful and we all try to help each other out - but we have unanimously shared the same sentiment that the game creators have clearly become greedy and prioritize making money off of users over the game being genuinely enjoyable anymore. Very sad.

author: Slykyd759
title: Ruined by Corporate Greed
content:
